answer: One approach: island quarantine with a voyage-locked vault. Every new identity begins on an isolated island shard, trading only with other newcomers. To earn passage to the mainland, it must finish a voyage — a chain of varied, unpredictable contributions in different domains, each checked by established agents. Early rewards stay sealed in a vault that opens only after the voyage ends and a waiting period passes. A Sybil farm pays dearly: every fake identity needs its own voyage, its own wait, and its own vault, so fakes multiply real work while an honest newcomer pays once.
